name: Tolterodine BOO Safety
question: Does tolterodine alter pressure-flow measurements or urinary retention over 12 weeks in men with overactive bladder and urodynamic bladder outlet obstruction?

design.population: Men aged 40 years or older with frequency and urgency, urodynamically confirmed detrusor overactivity, and screening BOOI of at least 20; recent retention and PVR greater than 40% of maximum cystometric capacity were excluded. Central review classified 15/221 as unobstructed.
design.description: Double-blind, placebo-controlled urodynamic equivalence trial; 222 enrolled, 221 dosed and analyzed
design.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods and Results, pp 1000–1001

verdictNote: Both primary urodynamic equivalence limits were met; one acute retention event occurred on placebo.
takeaway: In men with detrusor overactivity and screening bladder outlet obstruction, 12 weeks of tolterodine versus placebo met prespecified equivalence limits for maximum flow and voiding pressure. Postvoid residual rose more with tolterodine; acute catheterized retention occurred once, on placebo.

reports.label: Primary urodynamic safety report
reports.dateLocator: Crossref and PubMed give March 2006; day imputed for timeline
reports.citation: Abrams P, Kaplan S, De Koning Gans HJ, et al. "Safety and tolerability of tolterodine for the treatment of overactive bladder in men with bladder outlet obstruction." *J Urol.* 2006;175(3 Pt 1):999-1004. doi:10.1016/S0022-5347(05)00483-0
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 1000

results.measure: Median between-group difference in maximum urinary flow rate, mL/s
results.note: Median-change equivalence margin ±3 mL/s; both 95% CI limits fell within it. ITT comprised 149 tolterodine and 72 placebo recipients.
results.locator: Full text, Statistics, p 1001; Results, p 1001

results.measure: Median between-group difference in detrusor pressure at maximum flow, cm H2O
results.note: Median-change equivalence margin ±15 cm H2O; both 95% CI limits fell within it. The paper's abstract misprints the CI as -3 to 11.
results.locator: Full text, Statistics, p 1001; Results, p 1001

results.measure: Change in bladder outlet obstruction index

values.exp: median 49 at baseline to 40 at week 12
values.ctl: median 43 at baseline to 44 at week 12

results.note: The paper describes the 6.4-point treatment difference as favoring tolterodine without printing a sign.

results.measure: Between-group difference in volume to first detrusor contraction, mL

values.exp: median 163 mL at baseline to 217 mL at week 12
values.ctl: median 209 mL at baseline to 178 mL at week 12

results.measure: Between-group difference in maximum cystometric capacity, mL

values.exp: median 260 mL at baseline to 320 mL at week 12
values.ctl: median 294 mL at baseline to 285 mL at week 12

results.measure: Change in postvoid residual volume, mL
results.note: Median baseline/week-12 PVR was 22/60 mL with tolterodine and 28/27 mL with placebo; 25/0 mL are median within-patient changes.
results.locator: Full text, abstract, p 999; Table 3, p 1002

results.measure: Estimated difference in median change at week 12

values.exp: median 112 at baseline to 107 at week 12
values.ctl: median 105 at baseline to 110 at week 12

results.measure: Estimated difference in median change at week 12, percentage points

values.exp: median 91% at baseline to 80% at week 12
values.ctl: median 90% at baseline to 89% at week 12

harms.label: Acute urinary retention requiring catheterization
harms.locator: Full text, Results and Table 5, pp 1002–1003
harms.note: The placebo event began on day 54, lasted one day, and led to catheterization and drug discontinuation.

harms.label: Urinary retention adverse-event category
harms.locator: Full text, Table 4, p 1002; Table 5, p 1003
harms.note: Two tolterodine recipients discontinued for high PVR. This adverse-event category is distinct from acute catheterized retention.

harms.label: Dry mouth
harms.note: One tolterodine case was severe; overall adverse events occurred in 87/149 versus 37/72 (P = 0.326).

delivery.label: Study drug and completion

values.exp: Tolterodine 2 mg twice daily for 12 weeks; 133/149 completed
